svg.title: Feedforward network: transform each token
svg.desc: Three independent token columns use identical first projection, activation, and second projection. The feature width expands and returns to the model width. Input and output retain the same token positions. The original Transformer uses ReLU and widths 512, 2048, 512. GPT-2 uses GELU.
svg.text: Each token separately. Same weights at all positions.
